text: ENEOS Corporation's own Company Overview states that its capital is 30 billion yen, a 100% investment of ENEOS Holdings, Inc. ENEOS Corporation runs the ENEOS brand's petroleum products business.
short: ENEOS Corporation is 100% owned by ENEOS Holdings, Inc.
